definition: The Stack Exchange site from which the question was extracted.
calculation: The plain host supplied through --site is copied to every selected question row.
interpretation: The value distinguishes communities because each Stack Exchange site has its own topics, accounts, and moderation practices.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.

definition: The date represented by the downloaded Stack Exchange dump.
calculation: The date supplied through --dump-date is copied to every selected question row.
interpretation: Every snapshot-based score, view, count, and text field is observed by this date, which defines the end of the observation period.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.

definition: The identifier assigned to the question by Stack Exchange.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.Id on the selected question row where PostTypeId = 1.
interpretation: The stable number supports record joins and identifies the same question across extracts and tables.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.

definition: The direct web address of the original question.
calculation: The site host and question_id are inserted into the address pattern https://{site}/questions/{question_id}.
interpretation: The address identifies the public question page when that page remains available online.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.

definition: The date and time when the question was posted.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.CreationDate on the selected question row.
interpretation: The timestamp places the question in a period or cohort. Stack Exchange dump timestamps are recorded in UTC.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.

definition: The most recent question edit time recorded in the dump.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.LastEditDate on the selected question row when that attribute is present.
interpretation: Comparison with the creation time identifies whether an edit occurred and gives the most recent recorded edit time.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no recorded edit.

definition: The question title stored in the dump snapshot.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.Title on the selected question row. XML entities are decoded during XML parsing.
interpretation: The value is the short wording displayed above the question body in the dump snapshot.
empty_value_meaning: Empty only when the source title is unavailable.

definition: The rendered HTML body of the question stored in the dump snapshot.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.Body on the selected question row with its stored HTML markup.
interpretation: The value preserves rendered formatting, code blocks, links, and images. HTML-aware software is required for display.
empty_value_meaning: Empty only when the source body is unavailable.

definition: The visible wording of the question body in plain text, including visible code text.
calculation: The HTML is parsed, and visible text is joined with normalized spaces.
interpretation: The value supports reading and text processing. Formatting is flattened into spaces while visible code text remains present.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source body is empty.

definition: The exact tag string stored on the question row.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.Tags on the selected question row with the original angle-bracket notation.
interpretation: The value supports source verification. Each tag appears between angle brackets in the original dump notation.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no source tags.

definition: The question tags in a simple list that is easy to read and split.
calculation: Each name between angle brackets is extracted, and the names are joined with semicolons.
interpretation: Semicolon separation yields the individual topic names. One question can carry several tags.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no source tags.

definition: The content licence recorded for the question row.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.ContentLicense on the selected question row.
interpretation: The licence, question URL, and author information govern sharing and reuse of question content.
empty_value_meaning: Empty for an older source row that omits the licence field.

definition: The identifier of the question author when that account is available in the dump.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerUserId on the selected question row.
interpretation: The identifier supports attribution and source joins when the author account is available.
empty_value_meaning: Empty for deleted or unavailable user accounts.

definition: The source display name stored directly on the post, mainly for authors without an available user identifier.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerDisplayName on the selected question row when that attribute is present.
interpretation: The source name supports attribution when Stack Exchange stores a name directly on the post.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source row provides no direct display name.

definition: The question's voting result at the dump snapshot: up-votes increase the value and down-votes decrease it.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates the net voting score and stores it in Posts.Score; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Positive values show more up-votes than down-votes, zero shows a balanced or limited voting result, and negative values show more down-votes.
empty_value_meaning: Empty only when the source score is unavailable.

definition: The number of times Stack Exchange recorded the question page as viewed by the dump snapshot.
calculation: Stack Exchange maintains the view total in Posts.ViewCount; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Higher values show greater recorded exposure. Question age and site traffic also influence this count.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source row omits the view count.

definition: The number of answers shown in the count stored by Stack Exchange on the question row.
calculation: Stack Exchange maintains the answer total in Posts.AnswerCount; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Zero denotes no answer in the platform-maintained count. Comparison with available_answer_count identifies source-row differences.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source count is unavailable.

definition: A Boolean indicator showing whether the Stack Exchange platform-maintained answer count is greater than zero.
calculation: The value is TRUE when stackexchange_answer_count is greater than zero and FALSE when it equals zero.
interpretation: TRUE means the platform-maintained count records at least one answer. A difference from has_available_answer indicates that the maintained count and the available answer rows describe different source states.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means Posts.AnswerCount is unavailable.

definition: The number of comments shown in the count stored by Stack Exchange on the question row.
calculation: Stack Exchange maintains the question-comment total in Posts.CommentCount; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Zero denotes no question comment in the platform-maintained count. Comparison with available_question_comment_count identifies source-row differences.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source count is unavailable.

definition: The identifier of the answer selected as the solution by the question author at the dump snapshot.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.AcceptedAnswerId on the selected question row when an accepted answer is recorded.
interpretation: A present value means that the author selected an answer as the solution. The identifier locates that answer row.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no accepted answer at the dump snapshot.

definition: The recorded date and time when a question in the closed state was closed.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.ClosedDate on the selected question row when a closure event is recorded.
interpretation: A present value means the dump records the question as closed. The timestamp places that moderation event in time.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the dump records the question in the open state.

definition: The number of word-like items in the question prose after code blocks and inline code are removed.
calculation: Preformatted and code elements are removed before visible-prose extraction and Unicode word-token counting.
interpretation: Larger values mean longer prose. Question length combines with content and response evidence during difficulty analysis.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no prose words remain.

definition: The number of characters contained in HTML code elements in the question body, including whitespace.
calculation: Posts.Body is parsed as HTML, and the text length of every code element is summed once.
interpretation: Zero means the question body contains no code element. Larger values indicate more code text.
empty_value_meaning: The calculated field is always present; unavailable body HTML produces 0.

definition: The number of non-empty lines inside preformatted code blocks in the question.
calculation: Each pre element is extracted, and its non-empty text lines are counted.
interpretation: Zero means the body contains no non-empty line in a preformatted code block. Larger values indicate more block-formatted code.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no preformatted code block is present.

definition: The number of hyperlinks in the question body.
calculation: The value equals the number of HTML a elements containing an href attribute.
interpretation: Zero means the question contains no hyperlink. Larger values indicate greater reliance on linked context.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no hyperlink is present.

definition: The number of images embedded in the question body.
calculation: The value equals the number of HTML img elements.
interpretation: Zero means the question contains no embedded image. Larger values indicate more visual material.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no image is present.

definition: The number of tags attached to the question.
calculation: The value equals the number of parsed tag names.
interpretation: The value is usually between one and the site tag limit. Larger values describe a question assigned to more topics.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no tag is present.

source: Posts answer rows with ParentId = question_id
definition: The number of answer rows that are actually available in Posts.xml for the question.
calculation: The value equals the number of matching PostTypeId = 2 rows in the dump.
interpretation: Zero means no answer row is available in Posts.xml. Larger values mean more human responses are available for analysis.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no answer row is available.

definition: Whether at least one answer row is available for the question in the dump.
calculation: The value is TRUE when available_answer_count is greater than zero and FALSE when it equals zero.
interpretation: TRUE means at least one answer row is available; FALSE means the available answer count is zero.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.

definition: The identifier of the earliest available answer by creation time.
calculation: Available answers are ordered by CreationDate and numeric Id; the first row supplies the value.
interpretation: The identifier locates the earliest available answer selected by timestamp and numeric ID.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no answer row is available.

definition: The posting time of the earliest available answer.
calculation: The value is the CreationDate associated with first_answer_id.
interpretation: Comparison with the question creation time shows when the first available answer appeared.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no answer row is available.

definition: The elapsed hours from question posting to the earliest available answer posting.
calculation: The question creation timestamp is subtracted from the earliest available answer timestamp, and the elapsed seconds are divided by 3,600.
interpretation: Smaller values indicate a faster first response. Zero represents an answer posted within the same recorded instant.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no answer is available or a valid non-negative interval cannot be calculated.

source: Question and available answer creation times
definition: The median posting delay across all available answers to the question.
calculation: The value is the median of all non-negative answer-posting delays.
interpretation: Half of the available answers were posted by this delay and half were posted at or after it. Larger values describe generally slower answer arrival.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no valid answer delay is available.

definition: Whether the answer named by accepted_answer_id is present in Posts.xml.
calculation: The value is TRUE when the available answers contain a row whose Posts.Id equals accepted_answer_id.
interpretation: TRUE means the accepted-answer row is present and its content can be analyzed; FALSE means the row is absent or the question has no accepted-answer identifier.
empty_value_meaning: FALSE when no accepted answer is recorded or its row is unavailable.

source: The available row identified by accepted_answer_id
definition: The posting time of the answer that is currently accepted.
calculation: The value is the CreationDate from the available accepted-answer row.
interpretation: The value is the posting time of the answer that is currently accepted. It records answer arrival and serves as the start point for that answer content.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row is unavailable.

definition: The direct web address of the answer currently identified as accepted.
calculation: The address is constructed as https://{site}/a/{accepted_answer_id}.
interpretation: The address identifies the currently accepted answer and supports attribution when that page remains available online.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no accepted answer identifier.

source: Posts.OwnerUserId on the available accepted-answer row
definition: The Stack Exchange user identifier of the accepted-answer author when the account is available in the dump.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerUserId on the available accepted-answer row.
interpretation: The identifier supports accepted-answer author attribution and source joins when the account is available.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row or its author account is unavailable.

source: Posts.OwnerDisplayName on the available accepted-answer row
definition: The author display name stored directly on the accepted-answer row.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerDisplayName on the available accepted-answer row when that attribute is present.
interpretation: The source name supports accepted-answer attribution when Stack Exchange stores it directly on the answer row.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source row provides no direct display name.

source: Posts.ContentLicense on the available accepted-answer row
definition: The content licence recorded for the accepted answer.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.ContentLicense on the available accepted-answer row.
interpretation: The licence, accepted-answer URL, and author information govern sharing and reuse of answer content.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row is unavailable or the older source row has no licence field.

definition: The elapsed hours from question posting to the posting of the answer that is currently accepted.
calculation: The question creation timestamp is subtracted from the accepted-answer posting timestamp, and the elapsed seconds are divided by 3,600.
interpretation: Smaller values mean the answer that ultimately became accepted was posted sooner after the question. This value measures answer posting time.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row is unavailable or a valid non-negative interval cannot be calculated.

source: Votes.CreationDate where PostId = accepted_answer_id and VoteTypeId = 1
definition: The first recorded day on which the currently accepted answer received an acceptance vote.
calculation: The earliest matching VoteTypeId = 1 date supplies the value. Public-dump vote timestamps have day-level precision.
interpretation: This day records the acceptance action for the currently accepted answer. Public vote timestamps provide calendar-day precision.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no matching acceptance vote is available.

definition: The number of calendar days from question posting to the first recorded acceptance day for the currently accepted answer.
calculation: The calendar date of question_creation_datetime is subtracted from acceptance_date.
interpretation: Zero means acceptance occurred on the question posting day. Larger values mean more calendar days passed before the recorded acceptance action.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when acceptance_date is unavailable or the interval is invalid.

source: Posts.Score on the available accepted-answer row
definition: The accepted answer's voting result at the dump snapshot: up-votes increase the value and down-votes decrease it.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates the net voting score and stores it in Posts.Score; the value is copied from the available accepted-answer row.
interpretation: Positive values show more up-votes than down-votes, zero shows a balanced or limited voting result, and negative values show more down-votes.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row is unavailable.

source: Posts.Body on the available accepted-answer row
definition: The visible text of the currently accepted answer converted from rendered HTML.
calculation: The accepted-answer HTML is parsed, and visible text is joined with normalized spaces.
interpretation: The value is the visible accepted-answer content with HTML formatting flattened into spaces.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row is unavailable or has no body.

definition: The difference between the highest and lowest answer score for the question.
calculation: The minimum available answer score is subtracted from the maximum available answer score.
interpretation: Zero means the available answer scores are equal. Larger values indicate a wider voting difference between the highest- and lowest-scored answers.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no answer score is available; zero when only one score is available or all scores are equal.

source: accepted_answer_score and all available answer scores
definition: The accepted answer position when the available answers are ordered from highest score to lowest score.
calculation: The rank equals 1 plus the number of available answer scores strictly greater than accepted_answer_score.
interpretation: Rank 1 means the accepted answer shares the highest score. Rank 2 means one available answer has a higher score, and subsequent ranks follow the same rule.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer score is unavailable.

definition: The number of comment rows directly attached to the question that are available in Comments.xml.
calculation: The value equals the number of matching question-comment rows; comments on answers are outside the agreed extraction scope.
interpretation: Zero means no comment row attached directly to the question is available. Larger values indicate more question-level discussion.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no question comment row is available.

source: Question comment and first-answer creation times
definition: The number of available question comments posted before the earliest available answer.
calculation: The value equals the number of question comments whose CreationDate precedes first_answer_creation_datetime.
interpretation: Zero means the first answer arrived before any available question comment. Larger values indicate more question discussion before the first answer.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no first answer is available; zero when an answer exists and no earlier question comment is available.

definition: The number of calendar days between question posting and the dump snapshot.
calculation: The calendar date of question_creation_datetime is subtracted from dump_snapshot_date.
interpretation: Larger values provide more time for accumulated answers, comments, votes, and views. The field controls unequal follow-up time.
empty_value_meaning: Empty only when either date is invalid.
